method: Real Edge browser with live local API; isolated SQLite database

checks.description: JPEG, PNG and WebP each upload once and display the server-returned cover
Unsupported MIME is blocked before upload and preserves the existing cover
5 MiB plus one byte is rejected by the browser before a request

actual.exactBoundary: Covered separately by isolated module check M05

checks.description: Corrupt and empty accepted-MIME files receive real API rejection, keep the cover and leave upload idle
Empty selection leaves state intact; selecting the same rejected file sends a fresh request

actual.method: Programmatic empty-file change and real browser file selection

checks.description: In-flight upload blocks a second upload, removal, draft save and product submission
Failed upload retains the old cover and allows the same file to succeed on retry
Removing the cover blocks product submission with the missing-cover message
Removed/reselected replacement is published and its cover persists after refresh
Draft restores title, price and uploaded cover; successful publication clears it
Non-upload draft image is ignored while other draft fields restore
Existing asset cover loads without upload and remains intact after an owner edit
Owner cover replacement persists; another user cannot overwrite it

screenshots.caption: A valid image is uploaded through the API and displayed as the single product cover.
An unsupported file displays the format and size message while retaining the existing cover.
A deliberately interrupted upload shows a network error and retains the previous cover.
Selecting the same file again succeeds, displays its new cover and clears the upload error.
Reloading the publishing page restores the saved title, price and uploaded cover from the local draft.
The published product remains available with the selected uploaded cover after refreshing its detail page.
An owner replaces the cover and saves the edit; the refreshed product displays the persisted replacement and updated price.
